controls.name: Zero Public Network Exposure on Stateful PaaS
controls.remediationDiff: Set properties.publicNetworkAccess = 'Disabled' and bind Private Endpoint in private-endpoints subnet.
controls.wafJustification: Eliminates internet-routable attack surface and enforces Private Link data exfiltration boundaries.

controls.name: Minimum TLS 1.2 / 1.3 Enforcement
controls.wafJustification: Prevents downgrade attacks against deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1 ciphers.

controls.name: Managed Identity Over Static Credentials
controls.remediationDiff: Set identity.type = 'UserAssigned' and remove connection-string / SAS key references.
controls.wafJustification: Eliminates static secret sprawl and enables Entra ID token-based RBAC.

controls.name: Availability Zones for Tier-1 Critical Workloads
controls.remediationDiff: Set properties.zoneRedundant = true across 3 Availability Zones.
controls.wafJustification: Protects Tier-1 workloads against single-datacentre power or cooling failures.

controls.name: Multi-Region Active-Passive Pairing for Tier-1
controls.remediationDiff: Configure secondaryPairedRegion (e.g. UK South -> UK West) with geo-replicated state.
controls.wafJustification: Meets RPO <= 15m and RTO <= 60m during regional control-plane outages.

controls.name: Mandatory Governance & FinOps Tagging
controls.wafJustification: Enables automated chargeback, incident routing, and data-classification policy scoping.

controls.name: SKU Right-Sizing & Non-Prod Auto-Shutdown
controls.remediationDiff: Attach auto-scale bounds or non-prod schedule metadata.
controls.wafJustification: Prevents idle over-provisioning in non-production environments.

controls.name: Regional Co-Location of Compute and Stateful Storage
controls.remediationDiff: Align compute and storage within the same primary Azure region.
controls.wafJustification: Avoids cross-region egress charges and inter-region RTT latency spikes.
